verdict.rationale: There is no documented region picker for CodeRabbit's cloud. The only route to controlling data location is self-hosting: the review agent runs inside your own infrastructure (coderabbit-docs-18), and on Enterprise you can opt out of all data retention (coderabbit-supp-2). That makes residency an infrastructure workaround tied to an Enterprise deployment, not a simple user choice. Missing for 10: cloud region/residency selection (e.g., EU/US data centers), documentation of where cloud data is stored, and independent corroboration of residency guarantees.
